limits: The bench exposes no control that severs a part of the bound body. The removal in expression-sever is the world's own: the bound seed-7 consumer dies between trial steps 33 and 37, and a dead body's parts leave the embodied reading exactly as severed parts do, since both gate on BodyPhenotype's living parts. No partial-sever window exists on this body: the expressing part set is constant while it lives and empty once it does not.
